Job Title: Environmental Monitoring Analyst Job Description The Environmental Monitoring Analyst performs routine environmental monitoring across manufacturing and laboratory areas to support product quality and contamination control. This role focuses on collecting viable and non-viable samples from manufacturing and utility systems, incubating and interpreting environmental monitoring plates, and documenting results in electronic systems in compliance with GMP and site procedures. It is an excellent entry point into the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, offering strong training, mentorship, and exposure to environmental monitoring, GMP operations, microbiology, and quality systems, with potential for long-term career growth into microbiology, quality, and laboratory-based roles. Responsibilities Perform routine environmental monitoring sampling throughout the manufacturing facility, including controlled manufacturing spaces and associated laboratory areas. Collect viable and non-viable samples from manufacturing and utility systems such as compressed gas systems and water systems (including WFI). Incubate environmental monitoring plates according to established procedures and read and interpret results with a high level of accuracy. Document environmental monitoring results clearly and accurately within electronic documentation systems, including LIMS or other paperless platforms. Maintain complete, accurate, and timely documentation and records in a paperless environment to support audits and regulatory requirements. Communicate findings, issues, and trends in environmental monitoring data to appropriate stakeholders in a clear and professional manner. Adhere to safety guidelines and good laboratory practices when handling samples, equipment, and materials in manufacturing and laboratory environments. Foundational knowledge of microbiology and laboratory practices relevant to environmental monitoring and contamination control. Job Title: Lab Research Analyst I Job Description The Lab Research Analyst I is a hands-on laboratory scientist who supports the development of new vaccines and therapeutics by studying immune responses through complex bench experiments, detailed sample analysis, and rigorous data generation. Job Title: QC Microbiology Analyst Job Description The QC Microbiology Analyst performs essential microbiological analyses that ensure product quality and safety within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. In this role, you conduct microbiological testing on raw materials, finished products, and environmental samples in accordance with established SOPs and GMP guidelines. You prepare media, maintain cultures, identify microorganisms, perform environmental monitoring, and calibrate laboratory equipment while carefully documenting and analyzing test results. You also contribute to method development, support validation projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement in laboratory and quality operations. This position offers strong career development opportunities, exposure to multiple areas of pharmaceutical quality, and the chance to directly support a mission focused on making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Responsibilities Perform microbiological testing on raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and environmental samples in accordance with SOPs, GMP, and GLP requirements. Prepare microbiological media and reagents, ensuring accurate formulation, labeling, and sterility. Maintain and handle microbial cultures, including storage, subculturing, and disposal in line with aseptic techniques and safety protocols. Conduct environmental monitoring activities, including sampling of air, surfaces, and personnel, and interpret results against established limits. Execute microbiological assays such as growth promotion testing and microbial identification using approved methods. Calibrate, operate, and perform routine maintenance on laboratory equipment to ensure reliable and accurate test results. Document all laboratory activities and test results clearly and accurately in laboratory notebooks, electronic systems, and quality records. Analyze data, identify trends or deviations, and escalate issues in accordance with quality and compliance procedures. Participate in method development and validation projects to improve or implement microbiological testing procedures. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Quality Control, Materials Testing, Sampling, Instrument Maintenance, Microbiology, and Research and Development to support overall quality objectives. Support continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory by suggesting process enhancements and contributing to problem-solving efforts. Follow all safety protocols and use appropriate personal protective equipment, including lab coat, safety glasses, and gloves, while performing laboratory tasks. Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant laboratory workspace that meets regulatory and internal quality standards. Manage workload effectively by prioritizing testing activities to meet project timelines and production schedules.
